description: Pushes one field worker's next check-in out, as Postpone on the Check-in tab does: staffId (from read the wellness queue) and optionally days (1 to 90, the page's default when omitted). Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: postpone_wellness_check
title: Postpone a wellness check-in
